selectionReason: CNN passed quality, size, determinism and +0.01 F1 over trees
validation: Synthetic injections only; each fold holds out all frames of one target. Final exported model refits all targets; these are out-of-fold metrics, not accuracy on real unknown objects. No human labels or external data.
snrDefinition: Peak injected native-pixel difference divided by post-injection tile MAD sigma
psfMethod: Background-subtracted stellar second moments within radius 3 native pixels; isolated finite peaks 10-500 noise sigma, axis ratio <=2, FWHM 1.2-4.5 pixels. Injection widths sampled from individual stars measured in each source frame; the brightness screen is a saturation proxy, not a calibrated saturation mask.
configurationSelection: Development validation, not an untouched benchmark: the CNN was chosen over gradient-boosted trees on these same held-out folds, and an earlier smaller CNN was dropped on them.
